evals.prompt: Move app workflow logic out of a widget into its owning layer.
evals.expected_output: Loads app-architecture for layer ownership and validates affected boundaries.

evals.prompt: This shared app service now belongs to a single feature; place it correctly.
evals.expected_output: Loads app-architecture for feature placement, checks callers, and makes a scoped move.

evals.prompt: Fix a null guard inside an established feature helper.
evals.expected_output: Does not load the architecture skill for a routine localized fix; follows scoped rules and verifies affected behavior.

evals.prompt: Add a generated Riverpod provider for a feature use case.
evals.expected_output: Loads app-architecture and follows canonical provider placement: keep generated use-case provider in the use-case file.

evals.prompt: This use-case wiring feels too scattered. Where should its generated provider live?
evals.expected_output: Loads app-architecture, checks canonical use-case provider placement, and does not create a separate provider file.

evals.prompt: Fix a null guard in an existing repository provider.
evals.expected_output: Does not load app-architecture for a routine local fix. Follows current provider pattern and checks affected behavior.
